concept.reason: Inspected author skeletal reconstruction with 5 cm ruler and real CT skull plus 2026 specimen figure suffice; no new concept images needed.

scope: Whole narrow-billed foot-propelled diving bird; AMNH FARB 30899 skull and genus-level comparative body reconstruction. No claim of an associated complete specimen.

scientific_limits.en: Genus-level composite living reconstruction, not a single articulated individual or a scan. Skull AMNH FARB 30899 was called V. iaai in 2025, reassigned V. notopothousa by Irazoqui et al. 2026. Body proportions use the published 2025 composite skeleton; soft tissues, feathers, webbing and colors are inferred. Exact avian affinities remain debated. Overall height is reconstructed from an author figure, not a measured complete animal.
scientific_limits.zh: 属级综合活体复原，非同一完整个体或扫描。AMNH FARB 30899于2025称V.iaai，2026改归V.notopothousa。身体参考作者2025综合骨架，软组织、羽毛、蹼和颜色为推断。精确系统位置仍有争议。全体高度按作者复原图估算，并非完整标本实测。

classification: Cretaceous neornithine bird; precise placement relative to waterfowl debated

scale.source: Torres 2025 Ohio skeletal silhouette has a labeled 5 cm bar; approximate head-to-ground silhouette is 8.6 bars. Rounded artistic reconstruction, posture dependent.
scale.dimensions_status: Head and bill are approximate proportions read from composite silhouette, not original osteological measurements. Skull JPEG unlabeled bar is NOT used as an exact ruler.

diagnostic_targets: Long narrow pointed toothless bill, no broad spatulate duck bill and no teeth.
Distinct small rounded braincase and slender slightly curved neck connecting to streamlined oval trunk.
Complete paired feathered wings folded along body, not penguin flippers or flightless stubs.
Strong rear-positioned hindlimbs with readable bent joints and long swimming toes; feet drive diving, not wings.
Short feathered tail, body and hindleg proportions follow author silhouette, not a generic mallard or giant penguin.
acceptance: Four exact-GLB views must reveal narrow pointed bill and strong hindlimb silhouette compared with supplied author skeletal and skull references.
Whole body remains, paired folded wings and feet present. No unqualified species-level composite claim.
2026 taxonomy and inferred scale retained in public scientific limits.
Technical two isolated rebuilds, dependency closure and independent visual review still required.
